productOnPage.title: Morris and the Magic Bell
productOnPage.author: Yoto
productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Countdown to Christmas with Morris and Whitney as they journey to the North Pole to return Santa’s magic bell! No one loves Christmas more than Morris, and when the first day of December arrives, he simply cannot wait to start decorating! While sorting through his countless boxes of wreaths, lights, and ornaments, Morris discovers one item that doesn’t belong to him: a beautiful, perfectly round, shiny golden jingle bell. Morris knows each and every decoration in his collection by heart… so who could this bell possibly belong to? Morris deduces that it could be none other than Father Christmas himself, of course! Without this magical bell, Father Christmas’s sleigh might not be able to fly… and Christmas could be ruined for everyone! Oh no!Being a very resourceful bear, Morris decides that – armed with his trusty Seeker Speaker directions device – he will travel the long and winding road to the North Pole to return the jingle bell directly to the big man himself. What could possibly go wrong?This winter, join Morris the bear, his new pal Whitney the rabbit, and the cast of characters they meet along their magical expedition. Go on zany antics, learn about different winter holiday traditions, find Father Christmas, and save Christmas for everyone! Tracks included: Introduction 1st December - Meet Morris 2nd December - Meet Whitney 3rd December - Why the Why 4th December - Block Tower 5th December - Argument 6th December - Elf Chase! 7th December - Pear Tree 8th December - Kwanzaa Prep 9th December - Kwanzaa Song 10th December - Farm Foolery 11th December - Rabbibee 12th December - Hanukkah Song 13th December - Flat Tire 14th December - Forest Night 15th December - Solstice Song 16th December - Tinsel Town 17th December - Short Cut 18th December - Reunion 19th December - Epiphany 20th December - Wooster 21st December - Found! 22nd December - The Gift 23rd December - Prep Day 24th December - Christmas Eve Credits
